title: secrets-veil can copy a masked value to your clipboard, never to Claude
description: When a token gets covered with dots, you can ask for it on your own clipboard; Claude keeps seeing only the dots. Opt in with SECRETS_VEIL_OFFER_COPY=1. A masked result opens the question dialog: Copy to clipboard or Keep hidden. Copy sends the first covered value to $.ui.copy only; the result the model reads stays masked.
